no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes its input and keeps only its own rows (snippet) through the records door.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Save words I send again and again as a snippet, with blanks like {name} to fill each time, or change one I saved", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:save-a-snippet and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Give title (what you call it) and text (the words, with {name} where something changes each time; a blank is a lowercase name in braces), and tags (short words) if you like.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: snippet (records:read, records:list, records:write).
